name: vwap_mean_reversion_v10
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, z-score deviations of -2.3 standard deviations from session VWAP (~50-70 spot points below the institutional benchmark at typical intraday volatility) represent the mid-level dislocation class — too deep for passive gamma-hedger fades but not deep enough to trigger the multi-buyer convergence of capitulation events. The VIX band filter 12-22 is the defining differentiator: VIX below 12 signals an ultra-calm regime where NIFTY VWAP gravitational pull is weak and 2.3-sigma events almost never occur; VIX above 22 signals a regime where sustained institutional directional flow can overwhelm VWAP reversion for minutes or hours, making the thesis unreliable. In the 12-22 band — normal to moderately elevated volatility — NIFTY's VWAP-benchmarked buy programs activate predictably at z=-2.3 because they face a 50-70 spot point lag against their benchmark, creating measurable urgency without the structural breakdown risk of VIX>22 sessions. The 1.4x volume confirmation (between panic threshold 1.7x and drift threshold 1.2x) detects the exact moment institutional programs shift from passive accumulation to active program buying as their VWAP benchmark lag breaches the urgency threshold.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset at session open (day_id boundary)
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP is cumulative — no lookback scaling applies. This is the institutional benchmark that buy-side TWAP/VWAP algorithms must beat. At z=-2.3, they are 50-70 spot points behind their benchmark, creating the urgency gradient that drives reversion in normal-VIX regimes.

indicators.name: close_std_180
indicators.purpose: 15-minute (180 bar) rolling standard deviation of close prices, used as the z-score denominator. This lookback is calibrated to our 30-120s hold time: we need the denominator to reflect the CURRENT intraday volatility context (not multi-hour history), but stable enough to avoid the extreme noise of 5-minute windows. 15 min is the sweet spot — shorter than v5's 240 bars (20 min, for VIX>15 sessions that need more history to stabilize) and shorter than v3's 360 bars (30 min, for extreme capitulation events where the broader context matters). The z=-2.3 threshold with this 15-min std corresponds to roughly 50-70 NIFTY spot points below VWAP at typical VIX 12-22 session volatility.

indicators.name: vwap_zscore
indicators.purpose: Measures VWAP deviation in units of 15-minute realized volatility. Threshold -2.3 is the distinguishing parameter from v1 (-1.5), v19 (shallow), v3/v5 (-2.7). It selects mid-depth dislocations that are large enough to activate VWAP urgency algorithms but small enough that they regularly occur in normal-VIX sessions, giving 2-5 trade opportunities per day.

indicators.name: rel_volume_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute (36 bar) relative volume baseline. Original used SMA(volume, 20) on 5-min bars = 100-minute window, which is unsuitable for 5-second bars (crosses multiple sessions). At 5s resolution, we need an intra-session baseline: 3 minutes (36 bars) captures the current participation rate without anchoring to pre-open or prior-session volume profiles. Chosen at 36 bars (midpoint between v3's 24-bar 2-min and v5's 48-bar 4-min) because normal-VIX program buying builds over 2-4 minutes — a 3-min baseline is responsive to this timescale without being too noisy (2 min) or too slow (4 min). Threshold 1.4x is between v3's capitulation-detecting 1.7x and v5's drift-detecting 1.2x.

indicators.name: vix_close
indicators.formula: India VIX close, aligned backward via asof join to spot bars
indicators.purpose: Dual-sided VIX band filter: vix >= 12 AND vix <= 22. VIX<12 excludes ultra-calm regimes where VWAP deviations at z=-2.3 are nearly absent (institutional algorithms have negligible benchmark urgency at low vol). VIX>22 excludes panic/crisis regimes where sustained directional flow overwhelms VWAP reversion mechanics. The 12-22 band corresponds to the 'normal market' VIX regime where VWAP reversion at mid-depth is mechanistically sound and historically reliable. Original used the same band (12-22 VIX filter), transferred directly because VIX levels have structural meaning independent of bar frequency.

conditions: at least 180 bars warmup from dataset start
buy_ce.confirmation: VIX band does regime selection; volume at 1.4x distinguishes program buying entry from thin-volume drift; z=-2.3 threshold is the urgency line. No multi-bar confirmation needed — at 5s resolution, the combination of all three conditions is itself a strong gate.

buy_pe.confirmation: Symmetric: mid-depth VWAP overshoot with volume surge and normal-regime VIX signals short-side over-extension as algorithmic sell programs reach urgency threshold.

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts (~10 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). At z=-2.3 in VIX 12-22 regimes, the existing dislocation is already 50-70 spot pts; a further 10-pt adverse move post-entry signals the reversion thesis has failed and the move is structural rather than a temporary overshoot. Calibrated between v1's 4 pts (shallower z=-1.5 entries need tighter stop) and v3's 7 pts (deeper z=-2.7 capitulation needs more room). For our 30-120s hold, a 10-spot-point further move in 24 bars is a clear thesis invalidation. R:R = 1:1.6.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option pts (~16 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). At z=-2.3 with 15-min std ~25-30 pts, the deviation is 57-69 spot pts. In normal-VIX (12-22) sessions, the first-leg reversion from z=-2.3 toward z=-0.8 covers approximately 20-30 spot pts in 30-90 seconds as VWAP-benchmarked programs absorb available supply. 8 pts captures ~50-60% of this expected first leg — conservative enough to exit before the reversion stalls, aggressive enough to clear costs. R:R = 1:1.6.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 14:30 IST — earlier than market close to avoid the afternoon liquidity thinning where VWAP reversion mechanics weaken as institutional TWAP programs wind down

filters.vix_filter: vix_close >= 12.0 AND vix_close <= 22.0 — dual-sided band is the core regime selector; removes ultra-calm (no VWAP urgency) and crisis (structural breakdowns) sessions
filters.time_filter: 09:30-14:30 IST only; first 15 min excluded for VWAP and rolling std warmup; 14:30 cutoff avoids afternoon vol thinning where VWAP institutional programs are less active
filters.volume_filter: rel_volume_36 > 1.4 — distinguishes institutional program buying from random tick noise; 3-min baseline is session-local
filters.trend_filter: none — this strategy fades extreme moves; trend alignment would directly contradict the reversion thesis
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at close prices, no bid-ask spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — normal-regime VWAP benchmarking mechanics are structurally persistent; risk is that VIX compresses permanently below 12 in calmer macro environments, shrinking the opportunity set

adaptation_notes: Original Strategy_95 is a 5-min FnO equity strategy on top-50 volume stocks with VWAP z-score -2.3, rel_volume > 1.4, and VIX band 12-22. Key adaptations: (1) Universe changed from FnO stock basket to NIFTY index — individual stock VWAP reversion is diluted by idiosyncratic risk; index VWAP is purely driven by institutional benchmarking flows; (2) Timeframe: 5-min bars → 5-second bars; (3) Rolling std lookback changed from 50 bars × 5-min (250 min = 4+ hours, multi-session) to 180 bars × 5s (15 min = current session regime only); (4) rel_volume baseline changed from SMA(volume, 20) on 5-min (100-min window) to 36-bar 3-min rolling mean (session-local); (5) VIX band 12-22 kept intact — same absolute thresholds because they represent structural VIX regime boundaries independent of bar frequency; (6) Hold time compressed from 30-60 bars × 5-min (2.5-5 hrs) to 24 bars × 5s (120s); (7) ATR stops replaced with fixed 5-pt option premium stop; (8) Session cutoff moved to 14:30 to match original's 14:30 cutoff (where program buying algorithms begin winding TWAP orders); (9) z-score -2.3 and rel_volume 1.4x thresholds carried directly from original as they represent a specific mid-depth dislocation class distinct from all other converted VWAP versions.
weaknesses: VIX band 12-22 excludes both ends of the VIX distribution — on very calm (VIX<12) or very volatile (VIX>22) days the strategy produces zero signals
Session cutoff 14:30 means only 3 hours of trading window — fewer opportunities than versions running to 15:20/15:25
z=-2.3 threshold may occasionally fire during slow, sustained directional drift that is not a reversion event — no trend filter to prevent this
15-min rolling std can be inflated by prior intraday spikes, causing z-scores to appear shallower when they are actually extreme absolute deviations
